# Setting up Discussions (for the maintainer)

Discussions is where members meet. Turn it on once:

1. Repository **Settings** → **General** → **Features** → tick **Discussions**.
2. Open the **Discussions** tab → ✏️ next to **Categories**, and create:

| Category | Format | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| 🙏 Introductions | Open-ended | Say hello |
| 🪷 Practice circle | Open-ended | Share practice, schedule online group sits |
| ❓ Questions on the teachings | Q&A | Ask about the Sutras, Dharma, Guru Rinpoche, Milarepa |
| 🤖 AI ethics | Open-ended | Discuss the case studies and the charter |
| 🌐 Translations | Open-ended | Coordinate Dzongkha, Hindi, Nepali, Tibetan and other translations |
| 📣 Announcements | Announcement | Maintainer updates |

3. Pin a welcome post in Announcements linking to `README.md`, `ETHICS.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.

Also recommended:
- **Settings → General → Social preview**: upload an image (a lotus or a mountain) so shared links look good.
- **About** (gear icon on the repo home page): add topics `ai-ethics`, `yoga`, `meditation`, `buddhism`, `dataset`, `vajrayana`, `mindfulness`, `responsible-ai`.
- Replace `YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME` in `MEMBERS.md` and `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml` with your GitHub username.
